purpose: Short everyday utterances with four different answers to the same semantic question, so two speakers in one scene always disagree and the options can list answers nobody said.
audible_rule: a recording counts only when speech recognition hears one of the utterance's audible tokens; each token names exactly one answer inside its scenario

scenarios.question_en: Where did the {appearance} say the keys were?
scenarios.reverse_question_zh: 哪位说话者说钥匙在{answer}？请描述其外观。
scenarios.reverse_question_en: Who said the keys were {answer}? Describe their appearance.
scenarios.direction_question_zh: 说钥匙在{answer}的那个人，在你的哪个方向？
scenarios.direction_question_en: The person who said the keys were {answer}: which direction are they from you?
